**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

**What I checked:** The planner flagged Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) as the likely location and noted the rule was probably absent. I read Section 3 in full, then ran targeted searches across the whole document for the standard MFN formulations — "no less favorable", "most favored/favoured", best/lowest price, rate matching, preferential/same terms, and references to other customers or clients.

**Result:** No MFN obligation binds Clear Capital anywhere in the Agreement. Section 3 sets pricing purely by reference to each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis. The only pricing-adjustment right runs in RadialSpark's favour, not ours (p0014: Contractor may change rates on 30 days' notice) — that is a separate commercial issue outside this rule's scope.

**One near-miss worth noting:** the sole "other clients" reference (p0019) is a non-exclusivity acknowledgement letting RadialSpark serve other clients. Because this rule is a *direction* rule, I confirmed the clause imposes no obligation on us to extend RadialSpark terms given to third parties and no duty to match a third-party offer. It is therefore not an MFN and correctly not flagged.

**On the fallback:** I did not invoke it, since there is no obligation to narrow. I also confirmed the Agreement contains no MFN running *in our favour*. Since the playbook treats a Customer-favourable MFN as "welcome" rather than required, its absence is not a deviation under this rule — though if Clear Capital wants best-pricing protection as a commercial ask, that would be a separate negotiation point rather than a playbook-driven redline.
